notes.title: Update Patch Notes – SteamVR Launch Fix & More!
notes.content:
Hey Warriors!
We’ve just released a new update with several important improvements and fixes — thank you for your feedback and support!
🔧 What's New in This Update:
✅ SteamVR Launch Issue Fixed
We’ve resolved the problem where the game wouldn’t launch properly through SteamVR. You can now jump into the action without issues!

✅ Return to Menu Anytime
You can now return to the main menu at any time using the radial menu – no need to restart the game manually. More control, more comfort!

✅ Bot Death Animations
Bots now have proper death animations, making combat feel more immersive and satisfying.
